walkthroughs.body_html:
Charge Q = I × t (amps × seconds). Moles of e- = Q / F.

Moles of metal = moles e- / n (charge on ion). Mass = mol × Mr.

Cathode: lower E° species reduced preferentially (e.g. H+ over Na+ in aqueous solution).

Anode: species more readily oxidised (lower E° for the half-reaction) discharged. Halides preferred over OH- if concentrated.

Anode: 2H2 -> 4H+ + 4e- (in acid) or 2H2 + 4OH- -> 4H2O + 4e- (in alkaline).

Cathode: O2 + 4H+ + 4e- -> 2H2O. Overall: 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. Continuous source of fuel; only product is water.
